settings.title: Life is Better with Birds
settings.subtitle: Wearable art inspired by Atlas, Peabody, and the birds of the Pacific Northwest.
settings.bird_panel_body: Every Atlas Dovy design is inspired by two small Barbary doves — Atlas and Peabody. From cozy mornings on the perch to Pacific Northwest adventures, these birds are woven into every piece we create.

settings.text: For bird lovers, by bird lovers

settings.title: Two Little Doves Changed Everything
settings.body: Atlas Dovy began the day two Barbary doves — Atlas and Peabody — waddled into our lives and never left. Based in the Pacific Northwest, we turn our love of birds, nature, and quirky daily moments into wearable art and goods for fellow bird people.

settings.title: Because Birds Deserve Wild Places
settings.subtitle: We donate 1% of every sale to Pacific Northwest bird conservation and habitat protection. Every purchase helps protect the places Atlas and Peabody — and millions of wild birds — call home.

settings.title: Keep Up with the Doves
settings.subtitle: New designs, Atlas & Peabody updates, and Pacific Northwest bird adventures — straight to your inbox.
